records.title: Process enable evidence preconditions
records.statement: The external control system may enable the scoped process only when the treatment path, process-exhaust capability, supply/makeup-air dependency, and required pressure-control evidence are available.
records.rationale: The recorded synthetic intent makes common dependencies and pressure evidence visible before later executable design.
assumptions: The external control system owns the permissive and FacilityOps only observes indications.
limitations: External sources are provisional or informative influences and do not directly mandate this sequence.
No availability definition, numerical criterion, timing, or evaluation rule is approved.

records.title: Duty-fan request boundary
records.statement: When the process is enabled, the external control system requests operation of the selected duty fan. FacilityOps observes the request but does not issue it.
records.rationale: The request must be represented as external controller evidence without creating a FacilityOps command path.
assumptions: The external control system selects the duty fan.
limitations: No controller mapping, command semantics, or request timing is approved.

records.title: Fan-operation evidence separation
records.statement: A fan command or request does not establish fan operation. Future fan-operation inference must distinguish controller request, VFD indication, motor/electrical response, and delivered airflow.
records.rationale: Distinct evidence categories prevent a controller indication or device feedback from being presented as physical process proof.
assumptions: Future inference will retain each source and transformation identity.
limitations: No inference vocabulary, precedence, independence rule, or sufficiency rule is approved.

records.title: VFD and electrical evidence provenance
records.statement: VFD feedback and motor/electrical response are separate evidence categories. Their provenance must determine whether they constitute independent corroboration.
records.rationale: A derived controller value and a physically independent measurement cannot be treated as equivalent corroboration.
assumptions: Future source metadata can identify shared origins and derivations.
limitations: No point mapping, measurement method, independence test, electrical threshold, or inference is approved.

records.title: Pressure-direction evidence
records.statement: Process-containment inference additionally requires differential-pressure evidence supporting the intended corridor-to-airlock-to-laboratory pressure direction.
records.rationale: Both accepted topology boundaries must remain visible in any later pressure-cascade inference.
assumptions: The qualitative pressure direction is synthetic project intent.
limitations: No pressure band, sign convention, tolerance, persistence, sensor uncertainty, or containment inference rule is approved.

records.title: Duty-loss permissive and standby request
records.statement: If supported duty-fan performance is lost, the external control system removes or withholds the process permissive and requests the standby fan. A standby request alone does not establish successful changeover.
records.rationale: The qualitative sequence distinguishes external control intent from the evidence needed to support later changeover inference.
assumptions: The external controller owns permissive removal and standby request behavior.
limitations: The adopted code is provisional and does not directly mandate this project sequence.
No supported-performance definition, timing, capacity, or successful-changeover rule is approved.

records.title: Common-dependency limitation
records.statement: A standby fan cannot compensate for loss of the shared exhaust path, treatment availability, or another required common dependency.
records.rationale: The accepted topology contains common dependencies that must remain explicit when evaluating redundancy later.
assumptions: Both fans use the same accepted shared path and treatment dependency.
limitations: No common-cause model, failure vocabulary, capacity rule, or evaluation logic is approved.

records.title: Treatment and makeup-air permissive
records.statement: Loss of treatment availability or required makeup-air capability removes or withholds the process permissive. Exact safe-mode fan behavior remains unresolved.
records.rationale: The qualitative project intent records common dependency behavior while explicitly leaving safe-mode fan behavior undecided.
assumptions: Treatment and makeup-air capability are required project dependencies for the scoped process.
limitations: No availability, loss, response, safe-mode, or fan-behavior rule is approved.
The external sources are informative influences and do not directly mandate this requirement.

records.title: Insufficient and conflicting evidence
records.statement: Missing, stale, suspect, overridden, late, duplicated, or conflicting required evidence must be capable of preventing a supported conclusion.
records.rationale: The package preserves an explicit path for insufficient evidence without implementing evaluation outcomes in this tranche.
assumptions: Later approved rules will declare which evidence is required for each bounded proposition.
limitations: No temporal semantics, duplication rule, sufficiency algorithm, outcome, or evaluation is implemented.

records.title: Post-action recovery evidence
records.statement: Recovery requires new post-action observations and a separate recovery evaluation. Alarm acknowledgment, reset, command completion, or return-to-normal indication alone does not establish recovery.
records.rationale: New observations and a separate future evaluation preserve the distinction between a recorded action and its physical effect.
assumptions: A future recovery evaluation will use controlled timing and evidence-sufficiency semantics.
limitations: No recovery threshold, hold interval, evaluation rule, operability decision, or return-to-service authority is approved.

records.title: Reviewer-visible indication classification
records.statement: A future reviewer view should identify each indication as controller request, controller-reported execution, device feedback, electrical response, or process measurement.
records.rationale: Explicit indication classes may help reviewers preserve the observation and inference boundary.
assumptions: A later accepted observation model defines the category semantics.
limitations: This AI-drafted requirement is proposed, inactive, and not approved for implementation or evaluation.

records.title: Replay configuration provenance
records.statement: A future replay package should preserve the selected versions of its profile, requirements, evidence categories, mappings, and source artifacts.
records.rationale: Version provenance may make later replay results reproducible and reviewable.
assumptions: A later accepted observation and replay model defines the persistent identities.
limitations: This AI-drafted requirement is proposed, inactive, and not approved for implementation or evaluation.
